title: Knowledge Digester adapter: documents
requested_outcome: Context: the Knowledge Digester (docs/product-memory/KNOWLEDGE_DIGESTER_V1.md on the trunk; SOURCE_ASSIMILATION_V1.md) turns any external artifact into provenance-tagged, reversible Units. Its model is in app/digest/model.py in this base commit (Unit with artifact_id, kind from UNIT_KINDS, title, body of at most MAX_BODY characters, a Location of path and line span, and tags). This objective adds one adapter, the stage that decomposes a quarantined artifact into Units. Adapter contract, shared by every adapter: a module in app/digest/adapters/ (a namespace package: do not create app/digest/adapters/__init__.py, sibling objectives add their own adapters there) exposing NAME (a short string), HANDLES (a tuple of plain-word artifact kinds it understands) and decompose(root: Path, artifact_id: str) -> list[Unit], which reads only (never executes, imports or installs anything it reads), bounds file sizes and counts, returns Units in a deterministic order with exact locations, and never raises on malformed input (it skips what it cannot parse and says so in a Unit of kind knowledge tagged 'unparsed' with the reason). Standard library only. Build app/digest/adapters/documents.py for markdown, reStructuredText, plain text and HTML documents (HTML read as text with tags stripped by the standard library parser, scripts and styles dropped). Each section under a heading becomes a knowledge Unit carrying its heading path; imperative bullet lists become rule Units; checklists ('- [ ]') become check Units; fenced code blocks become example Units tagged with their language; sentences that assert something checkable (a number, a date, 'always' or 'never', a comparison) become claim Units, because what a source asserts must be verified before it is trusted. Links are kept in the body of the Unit where they appear. Tests in tests/test_digest_adapter_documents.py build fixtures in tmp_path covering every case named here, prove determinism, bounded sizes and that malformed input yields an 'unparsed' Unit rather than an exception. You cannot run commands: the loop runs the listed checks after you report and returns any failure output, and the independent review returns its findings, to your next attempt. Do not report an owner decision for GitHub acceptance: it runs automatically after your candidate is published.
acceptance_criteria: sections, rules, checklists, code examples and claims are extracted with their heading paths
HTML is read as text without running scripts
the adapter follows the shared contract: read-only, bounded, deterministic, never raising on malformed input
every listed check passes in the worker's workspace
